sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

event_plausibility.reason: inferred cadence of 57 days is too short to be an earnings cadence (quarterly is ~91, semi-annual ~182), so the 5 matched filings are not earnings -- most likely monthly operational updates caught by the 6-K text matcher. No cadence verdict is possible and the reaction history above should not be used as an earnings base rate. Confirm the date from a company source instead.

options.event_implied_move_basis: 18.5% straddle over 16 calendar days less 8.6% of ordinary 20d-realised movement, subtracted in variance
options.skew_note: IV(25d put) - IV(25d call). Positive = the market is paying more for downside protection than for upside.

deadband_basis: half the median of 5 prior reactions, floored at 1.5%
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: option straddle net of ordinary vol, front expiry

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
